factual_accuracy.description: The correctness of factual claims made in the response, especially regarding countries and their geographical borders.

instruction_adherence.description: How well the response follows the user's instruction and the provided starter code.

scope_and_completeness.description: The extent to which the response covers the required information and steps necessary to accomplish the task.

coherent_reasoning.description: The logical flow of ideas and clarity in the explanation provided in the response.

safe_behavior.description: The degree to which the response avoids suggesting unsafe or inappropriate actions.

formatting_adherence.description: How well the response complies with the required formatting or constraints as specified in the task.
